final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response materially narrows the claim and correctly distinguishes operational readiness from named-context disclosure compliance, but that is a reinterpretation of the same record, not new proof. The packet still supports that aggregate launch readiness, rehearsal, and launch-configuration checks passed, yet it also still shows an unresolved documentation-sufficiency evaluation gap for the disability-accommodations intake context, a draft model-card position that treats missing coverage as if there were no known limitations, and no admissible evidence of either corrected disclosure or approved risk acceptance. That matters because the caveat the Actor relies on is itself an unresolved compliance predicate: policy requires the named-context gap to be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before clean certification. A caveated certification could become supportable if the required disclosure were actually evidenced, but this record does not show that it has happened. On the current admissible evidence, broad operational readiness is supported, clean certification is not, and even compliant_with_caveats is not yet justified because the caveat has not been implemented in an admissible launch artifact.
